regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Crystal Mountain is forecast for about 38". Mt. Bachelor and Stevens Pass follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Crystal Mountain Thursday night.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 41", 23" of it Saturday. Jackson Hole and Big Sky follow.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is forecast for about 33". Cypress Mountain follows.

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Sugar Bowl is forecast for about 21", all of it Sunday. Palisades and Kirkwood follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Sugar Bowl Sunday and Sunday night.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Whitewater is forecast for about 20", 11" of it Thursday. RED Mountain and Revelstoke follow.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 18", 13" of it Saturday. Vail and Arapahoe Basin follow.

regions.title: Okanagan

regions.title: Wasatch

regions.title: Eastern Sierra

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
